entities.summary: Massimo Taparelli, Marquess of Azeglio, commonly called Massimo d'Azeglio, was a Piedmontese-Italian statesman, novelist, and painter. He was Prime Minister of Sardinia for almost three years until succeeded by his rival Camillo Benso, Count of Cavour. A moderate liberal and member of the Moderate Party associated with the Historical Right, d'Azeglio hoped for a federal union between Italian states. Massimo d'Azeglio was a journalists & chroniclers from Turin (1798-10-24, Turin–1866-01-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
